notes: Text leaf with the author’s strong top-centre number 15 and a separate thin bottom-left foliation 30. The opening continues an argument about replacing anabelian aspects with abelian ones in an arithmetic context. It gives equality of H_1 maps and a finer hypothesis concerning extension homomorphisms, then begins the proof of Corollaire 3 by reducing to equality on points after finite base extension and passing to conjugacy classes of splittings. No diagrams or drawings occur. The first H_1 formula runs into the right edge; its final parenthesis is only partly visible, and an unobserved comma has not been supplied. Calligraphic E is read consistently in all three extension occurrences. A short bar-like stroke above the X in the lower first extension is retained doubtfully rather than corrected to the mathematically expected unbarred X. The separate barred-K extension is clear. The proposition/proof is incomplete on this leaf; no mathematical theorem has been verified or supplied from context. The lower shorthand for même remains unresolved because its lower stroke could be an entry-hook equality bar or a flattened m. The only listed old C mark resolved here is M1069, with a changes row against_C=true. All surviving uncertainty in deleted faire is retained. lines_read counts 22 ordinary baselines, three interlinear baselines, the heading and the top numeral; the bottom foliation is inventoried separately.
